title: Probing Negation Understanding in Vision-Language Models With Object Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.20852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Negation is a fundamental aspect of language understanding and it is important vision-language models (VLMs) are able to process it effectively. We investigate how VLMs process negation by analysing attention patterns of different models. We draw comparisons between human gaze and attention in models when processing affirmative vs negated statements. We compare object level model attention to human eye-fixations in both binary and multary settings, evaluating with both synthetic and realistic datasets. We find models generally do not follow human-like attention patterns when resolving negation, suggesting they rely on mechanisms outside of attention. While layerwise analysis shows that PaliGemma2-3B shifts object attention to the alternative under negation, our headwise ablations suggest this is a byproduct rather than a negation processing mechanism. translated_title: 通过物体注意力探测视觉-语言模型中的否定句理解能力
translated_abstract: 否定是语言理解的一个基本方面，视觉-语言模型（VLM）能否有效处理否定至关重要。我们通过分析不同模型的注意力模式来研究VLM如何处理否定，并在处理肯定陈述与否定陈述时，将模型注意力与人类注视行为进行对比。我们在二元和多元设置下，将物体级别的模型注意力与人类眼动注视点进行比较，并使用合成数据集和真实数据集进行评估。研究发现，模型在解析否定时通常不会遵循人类式的注意力模式，这表明它们依赖的是注意力之外的机制。虽然逐层分析显示PaliGemma2-3B在遇到否定时会将物体注意力转移到替代对象上，但逐头消融实验表明这只是一个副产品，而非真正的否定处理机制。此外，我们发现LLaVA-1.5-7B对左侧物体表现出空间偏差。
tldr: 该研究通过对比模型注意力与人类眼动数据，发现视觉-语言模型在处理否定句时并不遵循人类式的注意力模式，其观察到的注意力转移只是副产品而非真正的否定处理机制。
en_tdlr: By comparing model attention with human eye-fixations, this study finds that vision-language models generally do not follow human-like attention patterns when resolving negation, and the observed attention shifts are byproducts rather than genuine negation processing mechanisms.
